extracted.intended_audience: Members of the House Committee on Energy and Commerce, regulators, and the American public (stakeholders in the Volkswagen emissions matter)
extracted.subtask_description: A CEO's sworn testimony before a congressional subcommittee explaining an emissions-compliance scandal, offering apology, describing investigatory and remedial steps, and committing to cooperation and reforms. The document models how a corporation publicly addresses regulatory investigations and affected stakeholders.

rubrics_metrics.name: Offer a sincere apology and accept responsibility
rubrics_metrics.description: "I would like to offer a sincere apology for Volkswagen’s use of a software program that served to defeat the regular emissions testing regime." "we at Volkswagen take full responsibility for our actions"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apologize clearly and unambiguously; acknowledge that trust was broken (customers, dealerships, employees, public, regulators). Use language that accepts responsibility rather than deflecting blame.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooperate fully with relevant authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: "We are working with all relevant authorities in a cooperative way." "I am here to offer the commitment of Volkswagen AG to work with this Committee to understand what happened"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commit to open, ongoing cooperation with agencies (EPA, CARB, DOJ, State AGs) and legislative oversight; make that cooperation a prominent part of the public statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiate thorough investigations and hold responsible parties accountable
rubrics_metrics.description: "We are conducting investigations on a world-wide scale into how these matters happened. Responsible parties will be identified and held accountable."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Promise comprehensive internal (and where applicable, independent) investigations; communicate that investigations are underway, that findings are preliminary, and that accountability measures will follow once facts are established.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop and deliver remedies for affected customers
rubrics_metrics.description: "Our immediate goal is to develop a remedy for our customers." "We will find remedies for our customers"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make remedy for consumers the central operational priority; describe commitment to produce fixes/remedies and to implement them as a first step toward making things right.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical solutions must be tested, validated, and approved by authorities
rubrics_metrics.description: "Technical teams are working tirelessly to develop remedies... These solutions will be tested and validated, and then shared with the responsible authorities for approval."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain that technical fixes will undergo testing and validation before deployment and will be submitted to regulators (EPA/CARB) for approval; acknowledge that different vehicle groups may require distinct remedies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide assurances regarding vehicle safety and legality
rubrics_metrics.description: "As the EPA has said, these vehicles do not present a safety hazard and remain safe and legal to drive."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address immediate safety concerns directly to prevent panic; cite authoritative sources (e.g., EPA) when available to back safety claims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examine and reform compliance processes to prevent recurrence
rubrics_metrics.description: "We will examine our compliance, processes, and standards at Volkswagen and adopt measures to make certain that something like this cannot happen again."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commit publicly to internal reviews of compliance systems and to implement reforms; frame these as systemic fixes rather than solely personnel actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commit to regular, open communication with stakeholders
rubrics_metrics.description: "We commit to regular and open communication with our customers, dealers, employees, and the public... we have set up a designated service line and website... I have sent a letter to every affected customer."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concrete channels (service lines, websites, direct mail) and promise ongoing updates to affected stakeholders; show concrete first steps taken to communicate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be judged by actions rather than words—follow through publicly
rubrics_metrics.description: "We will be judged not by words but by our actions over the coming weeks and months."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acknowledge that credibility is earned through demonstrable follow-through; commit to measurable actions and to publicly report progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Withdraw or pause regulatory submissions when appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: "As a result, we have withdrawn the application for certification of our model year 2016 vehicles. We are working with the agencies to continue the certification process."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When certification or filings may be affected by the issue, publicly state willingness to withdraw or pause submissions and to re-engage with regulators after corrective steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volunteer early engagement with oversight bodies
rubrics_metrics.description: "I have volunteered to come before this Committee at the very outset of these inquiries in an effort to show our commitment to cooperation."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proactively offer testimony/briefings to oversight entities early in the investigation to demonstrate transparency and willingness to be scrutinized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contextualize the incident within company values and prior commitments
rubrics_metrics.description: "These events are fundamentally contrary to Volkswagen’s core principles... Our commitment to preserving our environment..." followed by examples of past environmental efforts (LEED certification of Chattanooga plant).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contrast the incident with the organization's professed values and prior positive actions to acknowledge inconsistency while reaffirming commitment to those values—avoid using past achievements to excuse wrongdoing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage expectations about the preliminary nature of information
rubrics_metrics.description: "My testimony and my answers to your questions will, by necessity, have to be considered preliminary and based on my best current recollection and information."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state when information is preliminary and subject to change; ask for understanding while investigations continue to avoid overpromising.
